status_summary: As of 2026-10-07 Federal Student Aid remains inside ED and no government corporation exists. On 2026-03-19 ED and Treasury announced a Federal Student Assistance Partnership under a new interagency agreement; in its first phase Treasury takes operational responsibility for collecting defaulted federal student loans, and later phases may extend Treasury support to loans not in default and other FSA functions (Federal News Network reports these could include FAFSA administration), with no dates given. A House committee package advanced in July 2026 includes a bill to codify moving student loan administration to Treasury, with no floor vote found. No action toward private, government-guaranteed lending was found in the sources reviewed.
